title: Muscovite Mica Flakes and Mica Powder for Industrial Applications
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the physical requirements of muscovite mica flakes, mica powder and micronized mica for various applications. 1.2 The requirements of mica scrap do not form part of this standard.
clause_3_terminology: Muscovite Mica Flakes and Mica Powder for Industrial Applications

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
